text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange was the most active Arab bourse in the fourth quarter of 1996, National Bank of Kuwait report says.
- British business team visits Kuwait to promote services.

- Kuwait's Crown Prince and Prime Minister Sheikh Saad al- Abdulla al-Sabah returns to Kuwait soon, Defence Minister Sheikh Salem Sabah al-Salem al-Sabah said on Sunday. Sheikh Saad flew to London last Monday to follow up treatment after undergoing colon surgery in Kuwait.
- Supreme committee for implementing Islamic law completes bill meant to govern the operations of Islamic banks and investment companies.
- Kuwait to impose obligatory health insurance on expatriate residents, Health Ministry official says. The Gulf Arab state provides health services free of charge for its nationals.
- United Real Estate Company wants to start tourism projects at Kuwaiti islands.
